brief: The 1,850 ft municipal pier, rebuilt in reinforced concrete in 1992 after the 1988 storm: a straight deck on tall slender concrete pile bents with cross-bracing, a broad concrete deck with white pipe rails and iron lamp standards, small gabled lifeguard and bait kiosks along it, a lifeguard tower midway and a wide octagonal T-head carrying the red-roofed diner at the end; flags and a plaza at the foot. Four photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

names.sign: SOLANA POINT MUNICIPAL PIER · EST. 1904 · REBUILT 1992
names.rules: NO SKATEBOARDS · NO BIKES ON PIER
